column1: # Filament drops (#61, FIL-DROP): what chance an NPC kill or a hacked site
# has of putting one filament into the world. Header in docs/content/schema.md.
# Authored: names and groups only, never a type id. Restart to reload.
# source: npc (a killed NPC; name = its class, as npc/types.tsv `class`) or
#   site (a hacked relic or data can; name = the site's archetype name:
#   relic, data). Case-insensitive. `*` as name matches any.
# kind: abyss (an abyssal key; its tier follows the system's security band,
#   filament_drops::tier_for_band) or jump (a random-jump filament).
# band: which space the row rolls in: letters h (high) l (low) n (null)
#   w (wormhole), or `*` for all.
# chance_ppm: parts per million per kill or per hacked can; one independent
#   draw per matching row, the first that hits gives one filament.
# weather: any, or a word the key's type name must contain (dark, electrical,
#   exotic, firestorm, gamma). Ignored for kind jump.
# why: the falsifier. Every rate here is [A] until the owner decides the
#   filament sources; a row of an unknown source or kind is skipped with a
#   line. A row `off` in `source` turns every drop off (the world switch):
#   delete it, or set `on`, to turn them back on.
source
on
column7: the world switch: replace `on` by `off` and nothing drops

column7: [A] a frigate rarely carries one; falsified by a player killing 3000 frigates in a week and seeing none, or ten
